name: Ellie’s Checklist
author: Ellie Miguel

sections.description:
QA and review checklist for supporting WordPress site development, launch and client handoff. I built it for my own projects, and after using it for a few months, I thought it could also be useful for other freelancers, developers and small teams.

The plugin is focused on safe diagnostics and manual checklist tracking. It does not install plugins, activate themes, delete content, edit configuration files, upload premium packages or make destructive site changes.

Features:

  • Setup review dashboard for common WordPress configuration tasks.
  • QA checklist sections for build, handoff and launch.
  • Automatic read-only checks for selected settings.
  • Manual states for checklist items: pending, done and not applicable.
  • Focus mode for unresolved checklist items.
  • Simple saved checklist state for administrators.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ellies-checklist/ or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Ellie’s Checklist in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Review the setup recommendations and QA checklist.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin change my site automatically?

No. The public version is intentionally limited to diagnostics, checklist state and manual recommendations.

Does it install premium plugins?

No. Premium plugin bundles are not included and are not installed by this plugin.

Who can access the checklist?

Only users with the manage_options capability can access the admin screen and save checklist state.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First public version for WordPress.org.
  • Provides a safe setup and QA checklist dashboard.
  • Removes private automation, premium bundles and destructive actions.
